glossary.name: Manufacturing & Sales Data Platform Glossary
glossary.shortDescription: Business glossary for the Manufacturing & Sales Data Platform, mapping SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, IoT, and platform-level terms.

categories.name: SAP ERP
categories.shortDescription: Terms from SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution module

categories.name: IoT Telemetry
categories.shortDescription: Terms from manufacturing IoT sensor data and predictive maintenance

terms.name: Customer Number
terms.shortDescription: Unique identifier for a customer account
terms.longDescription: The primary key for a customer in the SAP system (KNA1.KUNNR). A 10-digit padded numeric identifier. Maps to Salesforce Account.Id via cross-system linkage in the Silver layer.

terms.name: Material Number
terms.shortDescription: Unique identifier for a product or raw material
terms.longDescription: The primary key for a material in the SAP system (MARA.MATNR). 18-character padded identifier. Maps to Salesforce Product2.ProductCode.

terms.name: Sales Document Number
terms.shortDescription: Unique identifier for a sales order
terms.longDescription: Primary key in VBAK (Sales Order Header). A 10-character document number that links to VBAP (items), LIKP/LIPS (deliveries), and VBRK/VBRP (billing).

terms.name: Net Value
terms.shortDescription: Net monetary value of a sales document or line item
terms.longDescription: The net value (NETWR) of a sales order or billing document, in the document currency (WAERK). Excludes tax. Found in VBAK, VBAP, VBRK, VBRP.

terms.name: Customer Name
terms.shortDescription: Legal name of the customer organization
terms.longDescription: The business name (KNA1.NAME1). Contains PII — classified as Confidential. Maps to Salesforce Account.Name.

terms.name: Street Address
terms.shortDescription: Customer street address line
terms.longDescription: Physical street address (KNA1.STRAS). Contains PII — classified as Restricted. Used for shipping and billing.

terms.name: Sales Organization
terms.shortDescription: Organizational unit responsible for sales
terms.longDescription: SAP organizational unit (VKORG) that manages sales. Values: 1000, 2000, 3000. Each has distinct pricing and distribution rules.

terms.name: Currency
terms.shortDescription: ISO currency code for monetary values
terms.longDescription: Document currency (WAERK) in ISO 4217 format. Platform supports: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD.

terms.name: Created Date
terms.shortDescription: Date when the record was created in the source system
terms.longDescription: SAP creation date (ERDAT) in YYYYMMDD format. Used as watermark column for incremental loads. Also maps to Salesforce CreatedDate.

terms.name: Account
terms.shortDescription: A company or organization that is a customer or prospect
terms.longDescription: Salesforce Account entity representing a business customer. Cross-referenced with SAP KNA1 via Account.Id to KUNNR mapping in the Silver layer.

terms.name: Contact
terms.shortDescription: An individual associated with an Account
terms.longDescription: Salesforce Contact entity. Contains PII fields: email, phone, mailing_address. Classified as Restricted. 30,000 records in platform.

terms.name: Opportunity
terms.shortDescription: A potential sales deal being tracked through the pipeline
terms.longDescription: Salesforce Opportunity entity tracking deal progression through stages: Prospecting, Qualification, Needs Analysis, Value Proposition, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost. 50,000 records.

terms.name: Lead
terms.shortDescription: A potential customer not yet qualified as an Opportunity
terms.longDescription: Salesforce Lead entity. Contains PII (email, phone). Sources: Web, Trade Show, Referral, Partner, Cold Call, Advertisement, Email Campaign.

terms.name: Equipment Health Score
terms.shortDescription: ML-derived health rating (0-100) for manufacturing equipment
terms.longDescription: Predicted health score from the Random Forest predictive maintenance model (90% accuracy, 39 features). Thresholds: Critical (<25), High (<50), Medium (<75), Low (>=75). Stored in gold/equipment_health_scores.parquet.

terms.name: IoT Telemetry
terms.shortDescription: Real-time sensor readings from manufacturing equipment
terms.longDescription: Sensor data from 200 devices across 5 plants and 4 production lines (LINE-A through LINE-D). Sensor types: temperature, pressure, vibration, humidity, flow_rate, power. Equipment follows lifecycle state machine: HEALTHY -> DEGRADING -> WARNING -> CRITICAL -> FAILED -> MAINTAINED. 500K records in bronze layer.

terms.name: Failure Risk
terms.shortDescription: Predicted risk level for equipment failure within the next 30 days
terms.longDescription: Classification from the predictive maintenance ML model. Classes: Low, Medium, High, Critical. Based on sensor feature aggregation with key predictors: bad_reading_pct (16%), anomaly_count (13%), temperature_mean (5.3%).

terms.name: Medallion Layer
terms.shortDescription: The bronze/silver/gold tier of the data lakehouse architecture
terms.longDescription: Three-layer architecture: Bronze = raw immutable data (Parquet, append-only); Silver = cleansed, validated, conformed, deduped (Delta); Gold = business aggregates, star schemas, ML features (Delta).

terms.name: Active Customer
terms.shortDescription: A customer with at least one sales order in the trailing 12 months
terms.longDescription: Business definition: a KNA1 customer with at least one VBAK order where ERDAT is within the last 365 days and order status is not Cancelled. Used in Gold layer aggregations and Customer 360 RAG documents.

terms.name: Revenue
terms.shortDescription: Total billed net value (NETWR) for completed sales orders
terms.longDescription: Aggregated from VBRK/VBRP billing documents where billing status is Complete. Always in document currency (WAERK). Cross-referenced with Salesforce Opportunity.Amount for reconciliation.

terms.name: Customer 360
terms.shortDescription: Unified customer profile combining data from all source systems
terms.longDescription: RAG document type aggregating SAP customer master (KNA1), billing history (VBRK/VBRP), Salesforce Account, Contacts, Opportunities, and Cases into a single Markdown profile per customer. 10,000 documents in rag-documents/customer-profiles/.
